blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Media Center (IMC) at the World Trade Center in Pasay City officially opened on Friday for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits. This will serve as the working area for thousands of media delegates from Asean countries. It will also be used by dialogue partners including China, Japan, Republic of Korea and United States, among others as they monitor the summits happening on Nov. 15-17.
